final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, si.riskeval, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.riskeval), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.zoneref, g.riskeval, g.avg_pressratio, g.record_count, CAST(g.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM grouped AS g JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
